name: 24541 · Danville, VA
findings: ZIP 24541 (Danville) has 134 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 32 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24541 (Danville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 24541 (Danville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
